_about: The lobby controls the generator does not act on yet, per layout (S414, K: "instead of having sliders that don't do anything, we should grey out the ones that don't do anything yet"). { lever: { "<template name>" | "*named" | "*classic" | "*random": "one plain line: what it does not do here, and what it will do once built" } }. Measured on 2026-11-21 by making a map at the bottom and at the top of each control on each layout (72 x 72 and 108 x 108, two levels, four players, water on) and comparing the objects, monster stacks, terrain and roads; a control that changed nothing on a layout is listed for it, and one that only scales a template's own value is not. Only a layout where the reason holds for every size and player count is listed (a Jebus Cross has one neutral zone whatever the size). tools/gen_vcmi_ui.js writes it into mapGenTab.json ("inert") and the sentences into english.json; DMB's lobby greys the control and shows the sentence in its right-click text. test/inert-controls.test.js.

layoutFamily.*named: Does nothing on a template yet: a template joins its biomes by its own links. Once built, it will rejoin the template's biomes in the family you pick.

zoneCells.Jebus Cross: Does nothing on this template yet: its biomes keep the sizes its file gives them. Once built, it will make its neutral biomes bigger or smaller against the starts.
zoneCells.Golems Aplenty: Does nothing on this template yet: its biomes keep the sizes its file gives them. Once built, it will make its neutral biomes bigger or smaller against the starts.
zoneCells.Headquarters: Does nothing on this template yet: its biomes keep the sizes its file gives them. Once built, it will make its neutral biomes bigger or smaller against the starts.

startZoneShare.Jebus Cross: Does nothing on this template yet: its start biomes keep the sizes its file gives them. Once built, it will give the starts more or less of the land.

richPlacement.Jebus Cross: Does nothing on this template yet: it has one rich biome, the middle one. Once built, it will move the richest treasure to the place you pick.

zoneCap.Jebus Cross: Does nothing on this template yet: it has one neutral biome and nothing to merge. Once built, it will merge its smallest neutral biomes to stay under the number.

zoneSizeVariety.Jebus Cross: Does nothing on this template yet: it has one neutral biome. Once built, it will make its neutral biomes more or less unequal in size.

interconnectPortal.Jebus Cross: Does nothing on this template yet: every way between its biomes leaves a start, and those never become portals. Once built, it will turn a share of the other ways into portal pairs.

interconnectivity.Jebus Cross: Does nothing on this template yet: every way between its biomes leaves a start. Once built, it will add or close ways between its neutral biomes.
interconnectivity.Headquarters: Does nothing on this template yet: its biomes touch only where its file joins them. Once built, it will add or close ways between its neutral biomes.

openPathNoRoad.Jebus Cross: Does nothing on this template yet: every way between its biomes leaves a start, and those keep their roads. Once built, it will take the road off a share of the ways.

openPathRoad.Jebus Cross: Does nothing on this template yet: every way between its biomes leaves a start, and those keep their roads. Once built, it will put a road on a share of the ways.

chokeGuardRatio.Jebus Cross: Does nothing on this template yet: every way between its biomes leaves a start, and those are always guarded. Once built, it will guard fewer or more of the ways.

guardGradient.Jebus Cross: Does nothing on this template yet: every guarded way leaves a start. Once built, it will make the guards weaker near the starts and stronger far from them.

guardDistance.Jebus Cross: Does nothing on this template yet. Once built, it will make guards stronger the farther they stand from the starts.
guardDistance.Headquarters: Does nothing on this template yet. Once built, it will make guards stronger the farther they stand from the starts.

guardPortals.Jebus Cross: Does nothing on this template yet: it has no portals. Once built, it will put a monster in front of every portal end.

lowLootRatio.Jebus Cross: Does nothing on this template yet: it has no open low-loot biomes. Once built, it will make a share of its biomes open ground with light loot.
lowLootRatio.Golems Aplenty: Does nothing on this template yet: it has no open low-loot biomes. Once built, it will make a share of its biomes open ground with light loot.
lowLootRatio.Headquarters: Does nothing on this template yet: it has no open low-loot biomes. Once built, it will make a share of its biomes open ground with light loot.
